race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Vélomédiane Claudy Criquiélion’s 102 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at Vélomédiane Claudy Criquiélion. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
